posts.title: A Day in Lisbon
posts.excerpt: Exploring the beautiful streets of Lisbon with my camera.
posts.content:
# A Day in Lisbon

Today I spent the day exploring Lisbon. The light was perfect for photography.

![Lisbon View](../fotos/SGRG_filmscan/SGRG-30.jpg)

*The MAAT museum with the Tagus river in the background*

The architecture here is stunning, and I captured some great shots.
